Balance sheet from the Statement of Net Position (p1) Total column; no liabilities printed. Other Local Receipts 299,747 split using the combined schedule (p15) and fund schedules: Activity Fund receipts 248,321 (p23) + Cooperative tuition 51,276 (p18) = Other Gov Funds 299,597, plus General Fund miscellaneous 150 (p8). Students 753,711 split by fund column into support services 356,860 (General) and student activities 396,851 (Other Governmental = Activity Fund disbursements). Transfers: governmental transfers_out 140,000 is the net transfer to the School Nutrition fund; other interfund transfers (General to Depreciation 200,000, Employee Benefit 50,000, Cooperative 80,000, Activities 125,000) are eliminated in the total column; the Activities 125,000 shows as General transfer out 265,000 less Other Governmental in 455,000 less eliminations 330,000. Other financing 4,968 = non-program receipts 15,753 less non-program disbursements 10,785. Detail: General Fund revenue from the budgetary schedule (pp8-9; Other Non-revenue Receipts lines are inside printed Total Receipts 9,151,628 whereas p5 shows non-program receipts as other financing); General Fund expenditure from the program-level disbursement schedule (pp11-12), which supersedes the function-only lines on p9 (not double counted; p9 transfers kept). Hidden transfers: the p5 Eliminations column removes 50,000 (Instruction), 80,000 (State Categorical) and 200,000 (Facilities) from General Fund spending, matching transfers in to Employee Benefit, Cooperative and Depreciation; recorded as contra expenditure lines plus other financing lines, and the printed disbursement total 7,795,755 is kept (detail_total includes other financing). State categorical and federal programs mapped to instruction. Activity Fund recorded account by account from the per-account schedule (pp22-23: Athletics, Clubs and Organizations, Miscellaneous, Classes; zero-activity accounts skipped) instead of the one-line p21 budget schedule; transfers by account net to 125,000 (p23), matching the General Fund transfer to Activities.
